title: Evaluation of finite-variable power series in an adically complete ring
statement:
Let $C,T$ be commutative rings, $\alpha:C	o T$ a unital ring homomorphism, $I\subseteq T$ an ideal such that $T$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], $n\ge0$, and $b_1,\ldots,b_n\in I$. Then there is a unique ring homomorphism $E:C[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]	o T$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] which restricts to $\alpha$ on $C$, satisfies $E(X_i)=b_i$, and is continuous from the $(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$-adic topology to the $I$-adic topology. Explicitly, for $F=\sum_{
u\in\mathbf N^n}c_
u X^
u$, $E(F)$ is the unique element whose reduction modulo $I^N$ equals $\sum_{|
u|<N}\alpha(c_
u)b^
u$ for every $N\ge1$. Here $|
u|=\sum_i
u_i$ and $b^
u=\prod_i b_i^{
u_i}$. Continuity means that for each $N$ there is an $M$ such that $E((X_1,\ldots,X_n)^M)\subseteq I^N$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NL (lemma-power-series-ring-over-Cohen-fs), proof, the universal property of power series rings; Lemma Tag 07NN (lemma-embed-map-Noetherian-complete-local-rings), proof, construction of the perturbed power series homomorphism. Explicit algebraic version of the universal property used there.

proof.text:
*Existence, explicit formula, uniqueness.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-universal-property-complete] with $\Lambda=C$, $\mathfrak a=I$ (so $T$ is $\mathfrak a$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]), the homomorphism $\alpha$, and $t_i=b_i\in I$. It gives a ring homomorphism $E:=\Phi:C[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]	o T$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] with $E(c)=\alpha(c)$ for constants $c\in C$ and $E(X_i)=b_i$, such that for $F=\sum_
u c_
u X^
u$ the element $E(F)$ is the unique element of $T$ with $E(F)\equiv\sum_{|
u|<N}\alpha(c_
u)b^
u\pmod{I^N}$ for every $N\ge1$: this is the explicit formula of the statement. The same node says $E$ is the only ring homomorphism $C[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]	o T$ restricting to $\alpha$ on $C$ with $X_i\mapsto b_i$, with no continuity assumed; a fortiori $E$ is the only continuous one, which is the uniqueness clause of the statement once $E$ is shown continuous (step 3).

proof.text:
*Elements of $(X_1,\ldots,X_n)^M$ have no terms of degree $<M$.* Let $M\ge1$ and $\mathfrak X=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)\subseteq C[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$. The ideal $\mathfrak X^M$ is generated by the products of $M$ of the generators $X_i$, i.e. by the monomials $X^\mu$ with $|\mu|=M$, so every $F\in\mathfrak X^M$ is a finite sum $F=\sum_kX^{\mu_k}g_k$ with $|\mu_k|=M$ and $g_k\in C[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$. By the product formula of [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], the coefficient of $X^{\mu}g$ at $
u$ is $\sum_{\mu'+\lambda=
u,\,\mu'=\mu}g_\lambda$, which is $0$ unless $\mu\le
u$ componentwise, and $\mu\le
u$ forces $|
u|\ge|\mu|=M$. Summing (sums are coefficientwise), every coefficient $c_
u$ of $F$ with $|
u|<M$ is $0$. (For $n=0$, $\mathfrak X=0$ and $\mathfrak X^M=0$ for $M\ge1$, consistent with this.)

proof.text:
*Continuity: $E(\mathfrak X^N)\subseteq I^N$ for every $N$, so one can take $M=N$.* For $N=0$, $I^0=T$ and there is nothing to prove. Let $N\ge1$ and $F=\sum_
u c_
u X^
u\in\mathfrak X^N$. By step 2, $c_
u=0$ whenever $|
u|<N$, so $\sum_{|
u|<N}\alpha(c_
u)b^
u=0$. By the explicit formula of step 1 (from [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-universal-property-complete]) at level $N$, $E(F)\equiv0\pmod{I^N}$, i.e. $E(F)\in I^N$. Hence $E(\mathfrak X^N)\subseteq I^N$, which is the continuity of $E$ from the $\mathfrak X$-adic to the $I$-adic topology as defined in the statement. With step 1 this proves every clause of the statement.

lean.statement: theorem exists_unique_adic_evaluation {C : Type u} {T : Type v} [CommRing C] [CommRing T] (α : C →+* T) (I : Ideal T) [IsAdicComplete I T] (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → T) (hb : ∀ i : Fin n, b i ∈ I) : ∃ E : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) C →+* T, (∀ c : C, E (MvPowerSeries.C c) = α c) ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, E (X i) = b i) ∧ (∀ N : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ F ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin n → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) C))) ^ M, E F ∈ I ^ N) ∧ (∀ E' : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) C →+* T, (∀ c : C, E' (MvPowerSeries.C c) = α c) → (∀ i : Fin n, E' (X i) = b i) → (∀ N : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ F ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin n → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) C))) ^ M, E' F ∈ I ^ N) → E' = E) ∧ (∀ (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) C) (t : T), (∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ N) t = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ N) (MvPolynomial.eval₂ α b (F.truncTotal N))) ↔ t = E F)
